parse_mutants: parse a comma-delimited mutation string like 'A45C,A56T' into sorted mutation tuples
apply_mutations_to_parent: apply mutation tuples to a parent protein sequence and return the mutated sequence
introduces_stop_codon: check if any mutation in a set introduces a stop codon
mutates_stop_codon: check if any mutation in a set mutates an existing stop codon
parse_mutants_empty: parse an empty mutation string and return the wildtype empty mutation tuple
